Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a quantitative cross-linking mass spectrometry (qXL-MS) study using DSS. While 'mod_tpp' is the closest modifier for cross-linking/topological proteomics in the provided list, the primary goal is mapping protein-protein interactions (PPIs) and conformational dynamics.

organism: Fusion proteins were expressed and purified from BL21 Codon RIL (Stratagene)
cell_lines: HeLa Kyoto WT (Identifier 5067) and HeLa Kyoto FUS-GFP (Identifier 5063) BAC cells
scope: In this study, we take a biochemical approach using purified proteins to reconstitute a chaperone-mediated quality control mechanism
we diluted purified FUS-G156E protein, called FUSm throughout this manuscript
The sequences of the measured recombinant proteins along with reversed and shuffled sequences were used for the FDR calculation

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (XL-MS) was performed on reconstituted condensates using purified recombinant proteins (FUSm and HspB8) expressed in E. coli. While HeLa cells were used for immunostaining, they were not the material analyzed by mass spectrometry.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a combination of genetic variants (HspB8-WT vs K141E) and chemical/molecular additions (RNA) to probe the structural dynamics of FUS condensates via qXL-MS. A significant portion of the MS data is time-resolved to track 'molecular aging'.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data were acquired in data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode and quantified using xTract in LFQ mode (label-free quantification) based on MS1 peak areas.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment is explicitly described as chemical crosslinking coupled to mass spectrometry (XL-MS) using the crosslinker DSS.

workflow: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
crosslinked by addition of 0.9 mM H12/D12 DSS
MS measurement was performed on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer... in data dependent acquisition mode
Quantification of cross-links by xTract in LFQ mode
Data were searched using xQuest in ion-tag mode
differential: Changes in crosslinking abundances were throughout the paper quantified against the dilute phase
log2ratios were calculated as the difference between the log2-converted MS1 peak areas
filtering was done on the level of the unique crosslinking site
Only crosslinking sites that were upregulated or downregulated twofold or more (log2ratio≥1 or ≤−1 and FDR≤0.05) ... were considered significant
search_parameters: crosslinker used throughout this manuscript, disuccinimidyl suberate (DSS), will react with primary amines and thus primarily link lysine residues
Carbamidomethylation (+57.021 Da) was used as a static modification for cysteine

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The analysis is site-centric (crosslinking sites) rather than protein-centric. The differential analysis compares the dense phase (condensates) against the dilute phase as the control.
